attributes.board_name: Arizona State Board of Dental Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Recognized Continuing Dental Education: seminars, symposiums, lectures or programs (in person or interactive audio-video), specialty board preparation/advanced training; self-study with exam, Board service, peer review, teaching, publications and charitable clinic service limited to 21 hours
rules.new_licensee_rule: Complete the prescribed hours by the end of the first full renewal period; no CE affidavit if initially licensed within the year before expiration.
rules.alternatives: Extension on written request (military service, missionary activity, foreign residence or other extenuating circumstances).
rules.audit_note: Affidavit with the renewal listing hours by category; Board audits yearly (random or for cause); documentation due within 35 days of notice.

topics.who: Infectious diseases or infectious disease control
CPR/ACLS/PALS hours; current card also required

rules.notes: Triennial license; renew by the last day of the birth month every third year (fee up to $650). 63 h: at least 36 clinical/health areas, max 15 practice management, 3 h CPR/ACLS/PALS (current card also required). 12 h for botulinum toxin/dermal fillers if provided. Sedation/anesthesia permit CE may count.
